Elon Musk predicts AI industry cash crunch in 2027

Elon Musk has warned of a significant cash crunch for the artificial intelligence (AI) industry in 2027. He cited the massive expansion of data centers, increasing chip costs, and construction delays as factors that will drive up funding needs. Musk questioned where the substantial amount of money required for these expansions would come from.
